input.summary: Unconditional PB convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no exit penalty; SFJ barred from convenience termination during the Term.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made PB's exit a genuine convenience right: termination on thirty (30) days' prior written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and we removed the 300% Development Cost exit payment that made the right unusable (conforming the related credit wording). We also barred SFJ from terminating for convenience during the Term. If SFJ prefers, our fallback is 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.oldText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time after SFJ has paid or incurred a total of $60 million of Development Costs and prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval upon [***] prior written notice to SFJ.
ops.newText: PB may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to SFJ, in which case SFJ will refund pro rata any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination.

ops.oldText: In the event that PB terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.2 then in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4, PB will pay SFJ, within [***] of the date of termination, an amount equal to three hundred percent (300%) of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ prior to such termination.
ops.newText: In the event that PB terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.2, PB will owe SFJ no termination fee or other payment for such termination, and will acquire the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4.

ops.oldText: , and reduced by the amount previously paid by PB to SFJ pursuant to this Section 14.2.2.

ops.text: 14.2.11 No Termination for Convenience by SFJ. SFJ shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Term.
